description: Synthetic non-well ontology. It checks that the builder loads, prompts, validates and matches under another ontology without code changes; it is not a delivered domain.

page_count.description: number of pages in the edition

release_date.description: date the book went on sale (YYYY-MM-DD)

chapter_pages.description: number of pages in one chapter; chapter is its number

extraction.task: You extract facts from a library catalogue page into JSON.
rules: One claim per value. "book" is a book title, never a series or publisher name.
